annotations.annotation_text: The eternal fraternal dialectic between opposing sons Shem the Penman (the introvert, rebel, artist) and Shaun the Post (the materialist, orator, politician), embodied in "jerry".
sources: Atherton, James S. The Books at the Wake. https://archive.org/details/booksatwake0000athe

annotations.annotation_text: The theme of the cosmic and comic Fall (broken): Tim Finnegan tumbling from his ladder, Humpty Dumpty shattered from the wall, and Adam falling in Eden, awaiting whiskey-fuelled resurrection.
